title: Task
description: One task, as tasks.json and tasks-archive.json keep it (docs/v4/data-model.md §4). Unknown fields are kept as they are.

type.description: A type ID from the vocabulary (meta.types)

status.description: A status ID from the vocabulary (meta.statuses); atm acts on its kind

phase.description: Before sprints: the task's phase (atm migrate turns phases into sprints)

priority.description: A priority ID from the vocabulary ("P0"…"P3" by default); missing means the default priority

labels.description: Free-form tags that group tasks across sprints and types, e.g. ["spike-2", "ux"] (DM-4.6)

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC; set when the task moves to in progress

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC; set when the task is done

skipped_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC; set when the task is skipped (atm skip)

agent.description: Before v4: the agent that started the task. Now started_by (readers fall back to it)

started_by.description: Who started it: the claim's owner

commit.description: The SHA of the task's commit

merged_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC; when that PR was merged (atm merged)

review_requested_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC; when the task asked for a review (atm review). Its work ended here; review time isn't work

waiting_on.description: A blocked task waits on a decision by the user or an agent (atm block --on)

questions.description: The open questions of a blocked task

blocked_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC; when it was blocked

blocks.description: Past blocks, oldest first, with who each waited on (T-244)

notes.description: Handoffs, outcomes, review requests, answers, rejections (docs/v4/data-model.md §4)

sprint.description: The sprint it is in (a sprint's name, meta.sprints); absent: the backlog

sprint_history.description: Each sprint it was in, from when to when; the open entry has no `to` (SR-2.5)

release.description: The release it ships in; when absent, its sprint's (SR-2.6)

review.description: How it is reviewed: blocker, async, batch or none

review_state.description: In the review kind: waiting, changes_requested, approved or rejected (SR-6.1, T-438)

reviewed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC; when the review was decided

sprint_review.description: A batch task done by an agent: pending until the end-of-sprint review, then reviewed (SR-4.4)

with.description: `user`: the work is done together with the user (SR-6.5)

related.description: Related tasks (a link that doesn't block), stored on one side and shown on both (SR-2.8)

resolution.description: How a finished task ended, when it isn't the default: wont_do, duplicate, obsolete or done (SR-2.8)

duplicate_of.description: The task this one duplicates (with the duplicate resolution)

kind.description: handoff, outcome, review, rejection, failure, answer or note

PullRequest.description: The PR that contains the task (atm pr): the task is In PR until merged_at (DM-4.3)

to.description: ISO 8601 UTC; absent while it is in the sprint

LastFailure.description: Before v4: the last failed attempt (now a failure note; still read)
